name: agent-observability
description: Privacy-first local view of GitHub Copilot agent telemetry. Raw data stays on your machine; only opt-in aggregates are ever shared.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Local Overview will summarize your GitHub Copilot agent activity from the on-disk telemetry database.

Local telemetry reading arrives in a later phase. Nothing is read or uploaded yet.

[Open Settings](command:agentObservability.openSettings)

Sessions will list your local Copilot agent sessions with prompt, tool, model, duration and success detail.

Session browsing arrives in a later phase. All session detail stays on this machine.

[Refresh](command:agentObservability.refresh)

Sync uploads only opt-in, aggregated, non-sensitive statistics to your organization dashboard. Raw prompts, completions, tool I/O and file paths never leave your machine.

Cloud sharing is OFF by default and arrives in a later phase.

[Set Organization API Key](command:agentObservability.setApiKey)
[Open Settings](command:agentObservability.openSettings)

agentObservability.dashboardUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the cloud ingestion API that receives opt-in aggregate batches (e.g. `https://dashboard.example.com`). Leave blank to disable uploads.

agentObservability.sync.enabled.markdownDescription: Opt in to share aggregated, non-sensitive statistics with your organization dashboard. Disabled by default (opt-out). Raw prompts, completions, tool I/O and file paths are never uploaded.

agentObservability.sync.intervalMinutes.markdownDescription: How often background sync uploads aggregate batches, in minutes. Minimum 5.

agentObservability.localTelemetry.enable.markdownDescription: Feature flag to enable the local telemetry view. When disabled, the extension does not read the local Copilot telemetry database.

agentObservability.sqlitePath.markdownDescription: Override the path to the Copilot `agent-traces.db` SQLite database. Leave blank to auto-detect the platform default location.

agentObservability.deviation.maxSessionM.markdownDescription: Maximum expected duration of an agent session, in minutes, used by the local workflow-deviation detector to flag overlong sessions (TimeoutExceeded) when no explicit workflow is configured for the repository.

agentObservability.workflows.markdownDescription: Optional per-repository expected agent workflows for the local deviation detector. When a repository has an explicit entry here, sequence and missing-step checks are enabled in addition to the always-on timeout and failure-rate checks. All detection runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

repository.markdownDescription: Sanitized repository this configuration applies to (e.g. `https://github.com/org/repo`).

workflows.markdownDescription: Expected workflows to check this repository's sessions against.

expectedSequence.markdownDescription: Expected ordered agent names. When present, enables sequence and missing-step checks.

maxDurationMinutes.markdownDescription: Maximum expected workflow duration, in minutes. Defaults to `agentObservability.deviation.maxSessionMinutes` when omitted.

sequenceDeviationAlert.markdownDescription: Flag sequence and missing-step deviations. Requires `expectedSequence`.

timeoutExceededAlert.markdownDescription: Flag sessions that exceed the maximum duration.

toolUsageAnomalyAlert.markdownDescription: Flag sessions with a high (>50% over >=3 interactions) failure rate.
